# Physio exercises

## Notes

- New shoes after 700 kilometres, the old ones are flat.
- Long run on Sunday, easy pace, around 250 kilometres.
- Strength training twice a week keeps the injuries away.

## Context

Easy runs should feel easy, I keep running them too fast. Protein with every meal, more vegetables at dinner. Emma joins the Thursday run, slower pace that day.

## Status

Physio exercises: clamshells, bridges, calf raises. Knee felt sore after the hill session, skip hills this week. Resting heart rate is down to 1500 after three months.

## Next steps

- Intervals on Monday: six times 800 metres with two minutes rest.
- Rest day means really resting, a walk is fine.
- Stretching after every run, ten minutes, no excuses.
